summary: The construction is valid in both cases. A line through the chosen integral target can be selected to avoid every other finite support point; the heavier open side has capacity at least half of the remaining total, which strictly exceeds the required residual mass because Y<p/2. Keeping the chosen target mass at least Y/4 makes that target a relative 1/4-center, and placing every added point strictly on one side of the line forces its only barycentric representation to be the point mass at that target, so the target-center set is a singleton and its D0-radius is zero. The specialization has Y0=256p/553<p/2 and Y0/4=64p/553, exactly meeting predecessor condition 2; the resulting strict pointwise bound implies |T_*|>553/64>8 and hence |T_*|>=9.
